title.narrative: Ghana Mushroom Growers? Needs Assessment Project

description.narrative: Challenges: •MGA is at an embryonic stage of development. There is no clear data on its strengths, weaknesses or organisational developmental needs to meets its strategic objectives •No data on the effectiveness or otherwise of MGA in meeting the expressed/implied membership needs and how to achieve its aspiration of becoming the ‘one stop shop’ of support for small scale mushroom growers •Necessity of reviewing MGA/membership for data on capacity building/technical development needs to build a case for international funding to meet these needs •Need for better co-ordination and synergy between MGA/members and key industry stakeholders and Government initiatives. Objectives •Review MGA, its overall business strategy in line with its stated objectives •Identify the capacity building and technical developmental needs of MGA and members •Identify opportunities for membership and service expansion nationally •Identify strategic stakeholders and local programmes MGA can participate in (creating synergies) Outcomes *Clear data on what is working well and what is not (gaps and priorities) *A full report with recommendations outlining the training and capacity needs of MGA and membership *An action plan with milestones within set timeframe and for expanding, improving and strengthening MGA
